narrative_purpose: Teaches the forest's four stacked layers and the steep vertical light gradient at a glance: emergent crowns in full sun, a dense canopy roof, a shaded understory, and a dim floor living on as little as 1-2% of the light — with fauna sorted by height.
subject: A majestic vertical cross-section of a Pandoran forest showcasing four continuous ecological strata from crown to floor: at the very top, giant emergent tree crowns bathed in bright golden sun with small winged creatures soaring around them; just below, a dense interlocking canopy roof of lush alien foliage; beneath, a dim, mossy understory of slender trunks, hanging lianas, and broad drooping leaves; and at the bottom, a deep shadowy forest floor illuminated by faint bioluminescent mushrooms, ferns, and a graceful six-legged grazing creature.
scene: A seamless naturalist speculative-biology vertical landscape painting capturing the dramatic descent of light through a giant rainforest from the sky to the deep forest floor.
camera: A wide side-on vertical cutaway perspective showing the full height profile of the forest.
light: A natural top-to-bottom sunlight attenuation: brilliant natural sunlight filtering through the canopy, progressively dimming through the understory into a mystical twilight on the bioluminescent floor.
palette: Luminous gold and pale sun at the crown, lush living greens and deep teals in the mid canopy, fading to dark indigo and glowing cyan bioluminescence on the floor.
style: Painterly speculative-biology naturalist plate with rich hand-painted oil texture.
detail_level: Crisp foliage textures, distinct atmospheric haze between levels, and clean framing for annotations.
composition: A unified vertical forest landscape clearly showing the four ecological zones with open dark areas on the left and right margins for interactive callout labels.
consistency_notes: Pandoran forest rendered in the book's cool palette; the four-layer separation and the dimming light gradient must read instantly; generous deep indigo negative space.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no diagram labels, no arrows, no photographic or 3D-render look, no lens flares, no neon UI glow, no cartoon or anime style
